rows.grounds: past passive participle used predicatively, naming or designating the subject
first member of compound qualifying the scope of tantras
second member of compound denoting the body of teachings
final member and head of compound, functioning as the designation

items.question: What designation identifies this work in relation to all tantric teachings?
premises: The work receives an explicit designation.
The designation characterizes it as an illuminator.
The scope of illumination extends to all tantras.
items.inference: Therefore, this work is identified as the illuminator of all tantras.
uncertainties: Whether pradīpikā is intended as a formal title or a descriptive epithet is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: It is called the illuminator of all tantras.
